source: Redfin October 2026 buyers vs. sellers report via BAM

headline: 41 of 50 big metros
*now favor buyers*
slides.fig_caption: More sellers than buyers nationwide in October
slides.sub: The widest seller surplus in Redfin data going back to 2013.

slides.label: active homebuyers in October, the *fewest on Redfin record*
slides.body: Sellers climbed to 1,526,984, the most since March 2020, while mortgage rates averaged 7.33%, up from 6.86% in September.

slides.title: The seller surplus, *by metro*
slides.note: Chicago rates as *balanced*: sellers and buyers within 10% of each other, by Redfin's definition.

slides.title: How the top 50 metros *break down*
points: *41 buyer's markets:* sellers outnumber buyers by more than 10%.
*3 seller's markets,* all in the Northeast. That ties April 2020 for the fewest since 2016.
*3.3% vs. 0.3%:* average annual price growth in seller's markets vs. buyer's markets.

slides.title: Buyers have *the edge*
slides.body: 61% of October sales closed below original list price. Price new listings to today's market, prep sellers for negotiation, and show buyers the room they have.
